name: Dubh & Lasta
source:
Dubh failed her Guardian's apprentice test, while Lasta failed his test for the Scout. Still wanting to get to work as one of Four Honorable Professions, Lasta suggested to Dubh they should try their luck applying to become a Scavenger. This meant they had to go to the capital city.

What were waiting for them at the capital? Is becoming Scavenger what they really wanted?

[From [url=https://linemancer.itch.io/dubh-lasta]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Dubh没能通过守护者学徒测试，Lasta也没能通过侦察兵测试。他们仍想从事四大荣誉职业之一，于是Lasta提议和Dubh一起碰碰运气，申请成为拾荒者。这意味着他们必须前往首都。

首都在等待他们的会是什么？成为拾荒者真的是他们想要的吗？

[来源：[url=https://linemancer.itch.io/dubh-lasta]itch.io[/url]]
